page.overview:
What is Kill ⁄ Ride Medley?

This is a combination of songs from Kill 'Em All and Ride the Lightning.

This version includes 6 songs with "Phantom Lord" instead of "Seek & Destroy". They played this version on the '94 Shit Hits the Sheds Tour and the Escape from the Studio '95 tour.

The new version replaced "Phantom Lord" with "Seek & Destroy". This was part of their set on the Poor Touring Me Tour (1996-1997) and the Poor Re-Touring Me Tour (1998).

Guilty as charged But damn it, it ain't right There's someone else controlling me
